Laser Powder Bed Fusion Additive Manufacturing of a Low-Modulus Ti–35Nb–7Zr–5Ta Alloy for Orthopedic Applications

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Peripheral Save for project in_vitro Exp. validation
Naresh Nadammal, Monika Rajput, Saurabh Kumar Gupta, Eugene Ivanov, Anigani Sudarshan Reddy et al. ACS Omega 2022-03-01 10.1021/acsomega.1c06261
单位: Department of Materials Engineering, Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore 560012, India
通讯: Kaushik Chatterjee @ Department of Materials Engineering, Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore 560012, India
相关性: 该研究涉及低模量钛合金的LPBF制备和生物相容性评估，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡匹配或疲劳性能。
边界: The paper lacks porous architecture design, stiffness matching analysis, fatigue testing, and surface roughness characterization.
动机· 开发适用于骨科植入物的低模量钛合金及其LPBF制备工艺
方法· 改变激光能量密度制备Ti-35Nb-7Zr-5Ta试样并进行力学与细胞测试
结果· 所有试样均表现出高延展性（25-30%）且成骨细胞附着良好
验证· 力学拉伸测试与体外细胞相容性实验
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To fabricate a low-modulus Ti-35Nb-7Zr-5Ta alloy via laser powder bed fusion for orthopedic implant applications.
Method· Samples were fabricated with varying laser energy densities and subjected to tensile testing and in vitro cytocompatibility assessment.
Result· All samples exhibited high ductility (25-30%) and comparable osteoblast attachment to commercially pure titanium.
Validation· Mechanical tensile tests and in vitro cell culture assays were performed.

Impact of contour scanning and helium-rich process gas on performances of Alloy 718 lattices produced by laser powder bed fusion

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Peripheral Skim only mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Camille Pauzon, Tatiana Mishurova, Marie Fischer, Johan Ahlström, Tobias Fritsch et al. Materials & Design 2022-03-01 10.1016/j.matdes.2022.110501
单位: Chalmers University of Technology, Industrial and Materials Science, Göteborg, Sweden
通讯: Camille Pauzon @ Chalmers University of Technology, Industrial and Materials Science, Göteborg, Sweden
相关性: 该论文研究了激光粉末床熔融中轮廓扫描和氦气对合金718点阵结构性能的影响，但未涉及生物医学植入物、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
边界: This paper does not address biomedical implants, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses on Alloy 718 lattices for non-biomedical applications.
动机· 研究轮廓扫描和氦气对合金718点阵结构性能的影响
方法· 通过LPBF制备点阵结构，结合X射线CT和力学测试分析
结果· 轮廓扫描提高几何精度和压缩性能，氦气减少飞溅但力学影响有限
验证· X射线CT和单轴压缩实验验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the effects of contour scanning and helium-rich process gas on the mechanical performance and geometrical accuracy of Alloy 718 lattice structures produced by laser powder bed fusion.
Method· Lattice structures were fabricated with varying contour scanning and process gas conditions, and characterized using X-ray computed tomography, uniaxial compression testing, and electron backscattered diffraction.
Result· Contour scanning significantly improved geometrical accuracy and compressive performance, while helium addition reduced spatter generation but had limited influence on mechanical properties.
Validation· Experimental validation through X-ray CT imaging and uniaxial compression tests.

Uncertainty quantification in fatigue crack-growth predictions

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project simulation_case UQ
Venanzio Giannella International Journal of Fracture 2022-03-01 10.1007/s10704-022-00624-4
单位: Department of Industrial Engineering, University of Salerno, via Giovanni Paolo II, 132, Fisciano, SA, Italy
通讯: Venanzio Giannella @ Department of Industrial Engineering, University of Salerno, via Giovanni Paolo II, 132, Fisciano, SA, Italy
相关性: 该论文提出了疲劳裂纹扩展预测中的不确定性量化框架，方法可迁移至植入物力学设计中的代理模型与UQ。
边界: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive FEA, nor does it involve implant biomechanics or contact mechanics.
动机· 疲劳裂纹预测受多源不确定性影响，需量化其对寿命分布的影响。
方法· 建立随机框架，考虑多种不确定性源，通过敏感性分析排序变量影响。
结果· 获得了圆棒疲劳寿命分布及输入变量的敏感性排序。
验证· 基于圆棒拉压载荷的数值案例验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Fatigue crack growth predictions are affected by multiple sources of uncertainty, necessitating a framework to quantify their impact on lifespan distribution.
Method· A stochastic framework incorporating multi-source uncertainties was developed, with sensitivity analysis to rank variable influences.
Result· The lifespan distribution of a round bar under tension-compression loading was derived, and input variable sensitivities were ranked.
Validation· Validation was performed through a numerical simulation case of a round bar under cyclic loading.

A Spline Dimensional Decomposition for Uncertainty Quantification in High Dimensions

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark UQ
Sharif Rahman, Ramin Jahanbin SIAM/ASA Journal on Uncertainty Quantification 2022-03-01 10.1137/20m1364175
相关性: 该论文提出的样条维度分解方法可用于高维不确定性量化，可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的代理模型构建。
边界: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or implant/biomechanics design, and lacks experimental validation in a biomedical context.
动机· 解决高维函数不确定性量化中的维数灾难问题
方法· 提出基于B样条的样条维度分解方法，构建正交子空间展开
结果· 低阶近似即可达到或超越现有高阶方法的精度
验证· 通过数值算例和34维随机特征值分析验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To overcome the curse of dimensionality in uncertainty quantification for high-dimensional functions, especially those with nonlinearity and nonsmoothness.
Method· A spline dimensional decomposition (SDD) is introduced using measure-consistent orthonormalized B-splines, creating a hierarchical expansion with dimensionwise orthogonal subspaces.
Result· Low-order SDD approximations achieve accuracy comparable to or better than high-order approximations from existing methods on nonsmooth functions.
Validation· Numerical benchmarks and a 34-dimensional random eigenvalue analysis demonstrate the method's utility.
spline dimensional decomposition · 样条维度分解uncertainty quantification · 不确定性量化B-splines · B样条curse of dimensionality · 维数灾难random eigenvalue analysis · 随机特征值分析
uncertainty quantification high-dimensional spline dimensional decomposition surrogate modeling curse of dimensionality

单位: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Faculty of Medicine and Graduate School of Medicine, Hokkaido University, Sapporo, Japan

相关性: 该论文通过有限元分析优化股骨截骨位置，涉及髋关节置换术后旋转稳定性，与用户研究方向中的股骨柄应力遮挡和微动分析相关。
边界: This paper does not quantify stress shielding or micromotion at the bone-implant interface, nor does it compare intact vs implanted femur or report Gruen zone strains.
动机· 确定全髋关节置换术中股骨截骨的最佳位置以提高旋转稳定性
方法· 建立四种不同截骨位置的有限元模型，施加轴向和扭转载荷分析应力分布
结果· 截骨位置在股骨柄近端40%处旋转稳定性最佳
验证· 仅通过有限元仿真，无实验验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To determine the optimal femoral osteotomy level in total hip arthroplasty for improving rotational stability under combined loading.
Method· Four finite element models with transverse shortening at 30%, 40%, 50%, and 60% of the Exeter stem length were constructed and analyzed under axial and torsional loads.
Result· The osteotomy at 40% of the stem length exhibited the lowest peak stress at the osteotomy site, indicating optimal rotational stability.
Validation· The study relies solely on finite element simulation without experimental or clinical validation.

Motivation· To improve osseointegration of titanium implants under osteoporotic conditions through surface functionalization.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To comprehensively review the occurrence, mechanisms, and influences of metal vaporization during laser powder bed fusion.
Method· A systematic review of experimental observations, numerical simulations, and theoretical analyses of metal vaporization and its effects on melt pool dynamics and defect formation.
Result· Metal vaporization is primarily governed by melt pool temperature and atmosphere, causing powder denudation, spatter, lack of fusion, and porosity; adequate energy input and shielding gas can mitigate negative effects.
Validation· The review synthesizes evidence from in-situ X-ray imaging and other experimental studies, but no new validation is performed.

Method· Five molybdenum-carbon alloys with carbon contents up to 2.2 wt% were fabricated via LPBF under constant parameters, and grain size was correlated with solute concentration using an Arrhenius-type equation.
Result· Carbon addition reduced cracks, increased density to 99.5%, and improved tensile strength from 50 MPa to 650 MPa.
Validation· Tensile testing and hardness measurements validated the mechanical properties.

Motivation· To investigate the effect of molten pool mode (conduction vs. keyhole) on thermal stress distribution during LPBF of Ti-6Al-4V.
Method· A coupled thermal-mechanical finite element model was developed and validated against experimental data from prior work.
Result· Keyhole mode reduces residual stress near the top of the part, while conduction mode yields lower stress near the bottom; stress along the deposition direction becomes dominant with increasing layers.
Validation· Numerical results were validated by comparing molten pool temperature, dimensions, and residual stress with published experimental data.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the influence of deposition plane angle and saline corrosion on fatigue crack growth in 18Ni300 maraging steel produced by LPBF.
Method· Fatigue crack growth tests in the Paris regime were conducted, with crack closure parameter, metallography, hardness, fractography, and corrosion/oxidation analyses.
Result· Deposition plane angle had negligible effect on fatigue crack growth without corrosion, but saline corrosion increased crack closure due to oxide-induced closure, reducing crack growth rate.
Validation· Experimental fatigue crack growth tests combined with microstructural and fractographic characterization.

Motivation· To investigate the effect of shot peening on the corrosion performance of anodized LPBF-manufactured AlSi10Mg parts.
Method· LPBF AlSi10Mg specimens were subjected to shot peening, anodizing, and residual stress relief heat treatment, followed by SEM imaging and corrosion testing.
Result· Shot peening alone deteriorated corrosion performance, but combined with anodizing yielded the lowest corrosion current.

Validation· Coating morphology, deposition weight, and adhesion tests were used to evaluate coating quality.

Motivation· To determine whether a hollow titanium stem can mitigate stress shielding in total shoulder arthroplasty for bones of varying quality.

Motivation· To evaluate the effect of single-dose locally applied lactoferrin on autograft healing and bone-implant contact in a rat peri-implant bone defect model.

Motivation· To compare the axial extraction force generated by different femoral stem extraction devices during revision total hip arthroplasty.

Motivation· To develop a parsimonious risk prediction model for periprosthetic joint infection within 90 days after total hip arthroplasty.

Motivation· To investigate whether the grade of the operating surgeon and supervision level affect the risk of revision after total hip arthroplasty using a national registry.

A Cadaveric Study Measuring Femoral Nerve Tension During Anterior Total Hip Arthroplasty Approach.

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore cadaveric Exp. validation
John P Livingstone, Trent M Tamate, Andrew K Richardson, Jeffery K Harpstrite PubMed 2022-03-01 link
单位: Division of Orthopaedic Surgery, John A. Burns School of Medicine, University of Hawai'i, Honolulu, HI
通讯: John P Livingstone @ Division of Orthopaedic Surgery, John A. Burns School of Medicine, University of Hawai'i, Honolulu, HI
相关性: 该论文研究全髋关节置换术中股神经张力，与股骨柄假体的应力遮挡、微动或骨-植入物界面力学无关。
边界: This paper does not quantify femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses on femoral nerve tension during surgical approach.
动机· 探究前路全髋关节置换术中股神经麻痹的机制
方法· 在6根离体股神经上安装弹簧装置，测量髋关节伸展和牵引时的张力变化
结果· 髋关节伸展时神经张力最大，牵引次之，拉钩放置可降低张力
验证· 尸体标本实验验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the mechanism of femoral nerve palsy during anterior total hip arthroplasty by measuring nerve tension.
Method· A spring device was attached to transected femoral nerves in cadavers to measure tension changes during hip extension and traction with and without retractor placement.
Result· Femoral nerve tension was highest during hip extension, followed by traction; retractor placement reduced tension.
Validation· Cadaveric experimental measurements.

Effect of Upper Limb Warming Blanket on Body Temperature Control During Total Hip Arthroplasty and Total Knee Arthroplasty

Yuta Mitobe, Kenji Nakagawa, Yasuko Baba, Tomomi Yoshioka, Yuri Yamaguchi et al. Journal of Current Surgery 2022-03-01 10.14740/jcs456
单位: Graduate School of Health and Welfare Science, International University of Health and Welfare, Tokyo
通讯: Yuta Mitobe @ Graduate School of Health and Welfare Science, International University of Health and Welfare, Tokyo
相关性: 该论文研究全髋关节置换术中的体温控制，未涉及任何生物力学或植入物设计内容。
边界: This paper focuses on perioperative temperature management using warming blankets, with no biomechanical modeling, implant design, stress shielding, micromotion, or FEA analysis.
动机· 探究上肢加温毯对全髋/全膝关节置换术中体温控制的影响
方法· 回顾性观察173例THA/TKA患者，比较不同时间点鼓膜温度
结果· THA组初始温度显著低于TKA组，需进一步研究温度波动对预后的影响
验证· 临床回顾性数据分析
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the effect of upper limb warming blankets on tympanic membrane temperature during total hip and knee arthroplasty under general anesthesia.
Method· A retrospective observational study of 173 patients undergoing THA or TKA, comparing tympanic temperature measurements at multiple time points using two-way ANOVA.
Result· The THA group showed significantly lower tympanic temperatures at the start of measurement compared to the TKA group, indicating differential temperature responses.
Validation· Clinical retrospective data analysis from a single institution.

Effect of Surgical Approach on Length of Stay, Cost, and Early Complication Rate in Total Hip Arthroplasty

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore none
Joshua C. Campbell, Sean S. Rajaee, Andrew Palosaari, Derek G. Ju, Charles N. Moon et al. The Journal of Hip Surgery 2022-03-01 10.1055/s-0041-1740553
单位: Department of Orthopedics, The George Washington University MFA, Washington, District of Columbia
通讯: Joshua C. Campbell @ Department of Orthopedics, The George Washington University MFA, Washington, District of Columbia
相关性: 该论文仅关注手术入路对住院时间、费用和早期并发症的影响，未涉及任何生物力学分析或植入物设计。
边界: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical metrics; it is purely a clinical outcomes study with no FEA, implant mechanics, or patient-specific modeling.
动机· 比较不同手术入路对全髋关节置换术住院时间、费用和并发症的影响。
方法· 回顾性分析1799例THA，采用多变量回归模型调整患者特征。
结果· 上方入路住院时间最短、费用最低、出院回家率最高。
验证· 基于医院行政数据库的回顾性统计分析。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare the effects of three surgical approaches on hospital length of stay, costs, and early complication rates in primary total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective review of 1,799 elective primary THAs from a single hospital administrative database, using multivariate regression to adjust for patient characteristics.
Result· The superior approach was associated with the shortest length of stay, lowest costs, and highest rate of discharge to home compared to posterior and direct anterior approaches.
Validation· Statistical analysis of retrospective clinical data from a hospital database.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare the clinical outcomes of 3-hole versus 4-hole DHS side plates in extracapsular hip fracture fixation.
Method· A retrospective review of 72 consecutive patients treated with either 3-hole or 4-hole DHS side plates by a single consultant.
Result· No significant difference in failure rates between the two groups, with slightly lower blood loss in the 3-hole group.
Validation· Statistical comparison of clinical outcomes from patient records.

Motivation· To report a rare case of neurogenic heterotopic ossification following critical illness polyneuropathy due to expanded dengue syndrome.
Method· A case report describing clinical presentation, surgical excision of ossific mass, and hybrid total hip arthroplasty.
Result· The patient showed good clinical outcome at 2-year follow-up without recurrence of heterotopic ossification.
Validation· Clinical follow-up over 2 years.

Motivation· To evaluate the clinical outcomes of conversion hip arthroplasty for failed DHS fixation of intertrochanteric fractures.

Motivation· To evaluate the impact of acetabular component placement on functional outcomes after total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective study of 30 patients measured acetabular cup version and inclination using CT scans and modified Murray's method.
Result· 90% of patients achieved excellent Harris hip scores, and 86.66% of acetabular cup placements were within acceptable limits.
Validation· Clinical evaluation using Harris hip score.
